caption: Front door — meet people where their product already lives.
Step 1 — What it is. Pre-filled if they snapped or pasted; just confirm.
Step 2 — the one real fork. “Yes” moves price & stock per option.
Step 3 — Details. One paste fills the facts; you glance and confirm.
Step 4 — Review & publish. Designed page is the default; draft-first.
Finish — a gap queue batched by field. Approve the AI, don’t type.
Import — AI maps any sheet to our fields; confirm once, lands as drafts.
